title: Purpose Canvas
description: L0 Purpose — Sinek Golden Circle (why/how/what) + JTBD anchoring. The framework's entry-point canvas, written first by /interview. Permissive AT ENTRY by design: a fresh brief writes a minimal subset, because Sinek's own diagnosis is that most people start from what they are building and cannot yet name the change they want true in the world — eliciting the why is this framework's job, not its entry fee. NOT permissive once work is DERIVED from it: `dependentSchemas` requires `why` as soon as `purpose_properties` exists, because binding properties derived from an absent purpose are derived from nothing. Added 2026-06-12 (gap analysis: the L0 entry point had no schema); conditional requirement added 2026-08-31 (v0.145.0) after a dogfood finding that nothing anywhere checked whether `why` was present.

why.description: Purpose statement — why this exists (Sinek). May be absent or empty AT ENTRY, but not once `purpose_properties` exists; see dependentSchemas. The empty form `why: ""` comes from the legacy (pre-plugin, v0.1.x) canvas template; current /mycelium:setup writes no purpose.yml at all.

who.description: Who it's for — JTBD-shaped user/cohort description.

definition_of_done.description: L0 outcome bar (worked instance lives here in dogfood; canonical per-diamond field is diamonds/active.yml — see schemas/diamonds/active.schema.json).

purpose_properties.description: Binding properties derived from why/how/what (v0.120.0). Extracted agent-proposed, human-confirmed; checked against every sub-element's purpose_stance. See docs/purpose-stance.md.

derived_from_hash.description: sha256 of normalised why+how+what. A mismatch means the list is stale and every stance below it is superseded.

hash_algorithm.description: Which algorithm stamped derived_from_hash. Absent means pre-v0.141.0, when the hash covered evidence as well as intent — a mismatch was then uninterpretable, because appending one citation changed it. Record this alongside a hash produced by a v0.141.0+ derivation.

confirmed_by.description: Extraction is agent-proposed and human-confirmed. 'pending' means no human has confirmed; checks stay advisory until they have.

verbatim.description: The user's own words this came from.

binding.description: Human-marked. Only binding properties are ever checked. This is the anti-noise mechanism.

contradicted_by.description: Named solutions that would violate it. A property with none is not checkable and should be an aspiration instead.

aspiration_reason.description: Set when a quality adjective could not be made checkable and the builder skipped defining it. Excluded from all checks; recorded so the skip is a choice, not a blank.

purpose_properties.description: Deriving binding properties from a purpose with no `why` is deriving them from nothing. `required` alone is not enough: a present-but-empty `why: ""` — the legacy template's shape — satisfies `required` while carrying no purpose, so minLength pins it. Entry stays open; derivation does not.
